test_recursive_iterate: test recursive_iterate to flatten nested dicts and lists into a linear iterable of leaf values
test_recursive_iterate_send: test recursive_iterate with send to transform values and reconstruct the original nested structure
test_recursive_iterate_yield_name: test recursive_iterate with yield_name to get dotted path names alongside each yielded value
test_recursive_iterate_yield_container: test recursive_iterate with yield_container to yield both leaf values and their parent containers
test_create_pair: test create_pair to pair two nested dicts or lists and iterate them as PairedDict or PairedSeq
